directionProbe.threshold: angle over 60° between dictionary and candidate start-to-end vectors
directionProbe.note: Every flagged character led to a correction; no flagged stroke was left as it stood. An endpoint assignment check over all fifty glyphs surfaced no order difference beyond the flagged 皮 (跛, 婆, 披), 長 (套), 馬 (騙) and 重 (慟) positions; the 巳 folds of 疱 differ by less than 0.3 in the 0-100 frame and keep the same order on both sides.

subThresholdSlants.method: direction-probe.mjs rows with an angle of 45° to 60°: 8 rows, none corrected
subThresholdSlants.note: Seven are short dots the dictionary draws vertically while the licensed corpora slant them (褪 1, 辦 1, 辦 10, 疱 1, 庖 1, 褒 1, 袍 1) and one is the 勺 dot of 豹 (10) the dictionary draws flat. Kept as licensed geometry, as in the earlier batches.

sourceTransform.note: serve.py, source-checks.mjs and direction-probe.mjs accept translate(x, -y); no glyph in this batch carries a horizontal offset.
